name: angelic_destiny_aura_never_returns_when_its_creature_dies
notes: KNOWN BUG, fails today (M4 mapper, 2026-11-17). Run it on the FDN record with `cardtool.py runpack FDN <this pack>` (tools/run_scenarios.py plays verified trees only). Printed: 'When enchanted creature dies, return this card to its owner's hand.' The record writes it as CreatureDiesEvent(IS_ATTACHED_TO_SOURCE) moving the Aura card (IS_SOURCE) from a graveyard to its owner's hand. binding.functions_from_graveyard reads a trigger whose effect moves its own source out of a graveyard as working only there (CR 113.6m) and misses the rule's Aura exception ('... unless its trigger condition ... specifies ... if the object is an Aura, that the object it enchants leaves the battlefield'): the ability is bound only once the Aura is in the graveyard, after the creature's death was matched, so it never triggers. Expected once fixed: seat 0 enchants its 2/2 Bear (6/6); 6 damage kills it; the Aura is put into its owner's graveyard (CR 704.5m) and its trigger returns it to seat 0's hand.
